settings.title: Model request timeout
settings.description: Maximum time for a model request. Provider limits may end a request sooner.

settings.title: Stream idle timeout
settings.description: Maximum wait between pieces of a streamed response.

settings.title: Default tool timeout
settings.description: Used when a tool call has no explicit timeout. A tool can declare its own budget.
settings.effect: Restart the connected CLIO service to update existing tool clients.

settings.title: Model retries
settings.description: Retries a temporary provider failure before any response has streamed.
settings.effect: Restart the connected CLIO service to update existing model clients.

settings.title: Automatic compaction threshold
settings.description: Context fullness at which CLIO prepares a summary. Session preferences take precedence.
settings.effect: Applies to sessions without their own compaction threshold.

settings.title: Save model reasoning
settings.description: Keep reasoning supplied by the provider with the saved response, when available.
settings.effect: Applies when subsequent responses are saved.

settings.title: Save transcript files
settings.description: Keep a separate transcript file alongside conversation storage. Existing files are retained.
settings.effect: Restart the connected CLIO service for this change to take effect.
